newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Spain rate move creates more room for Portugal.
newsitem.headline: Spain rate move creates more room for Portugal.

text.p: Spain's half-point cut gives the Bank of Portugal more room to lower its repo rate at the start of the new commercial bank reserve period on Thursday, but doubts remain whether it will do so, analysts said.

"I have not changed my mind...the desire to break any dependency on Spain and consolidate the decline in (money market) rates will make the Bank of Portugal do nothing," said Carla Rebelo of Banco Finantia.
Rebelo was asked if she had changed her view from a Reuter poll on Wednesday about the Bank of Portugal's attitude after the Bank of Spain cut its key money rate on Thursday.
The Bank of Spain went to the limit of the 0.25-0.50 percent cut forecast by the market, bringing its repo rate to 6.75 percent.

But Jose Carlos Andre of Banco de Comercio & Industria felt the Bank of Portugal had the space to shave 0.25 percent from its repo rate to bring it to 7.00 percent and still give the impression of being prudent.
The Bank of Portugal will announce terms for the next reserve period after 1415 GMT.
